---
name: Exporter request
about: Ask for a new place Sift can export your links to
title: "Exporter: "
labels: exporter
---

**Where should the links go?**
The app, service or format, with a link to its docs.

**What should one link become there?**
A note, a bookmark, a row, a card. Which fields matter: title, URL, theme,
use, next action, preview text, image.

**What should one theme become there?**
A folder, a tag, a page, nothing.

**Does it need an account or API key?**
If yes, exporters cannot hold credentials yet, so say how you would expect
to sign in.
